intro.text: building production ai systems and operator tools for domain experts

focus.name: health
focus.description: clinical lab analysis and personalized health optimization

focus.name: ai for domain experts
focus.description: forward-deployed engineering, custom agentic workflows, and training for senior practitioners and founder-execs

sections.title: primary
sections.note: linked entries point at public pages/repos; unlinked entries are private or operator-internal.

entries.name: skillbox
entries.description: private single-tenant dev box for you and your coding agents. docker-based, tailscale-first, with durable agent homes and client-scoped overlays.

entries.name: swimmers
entries.description: terminal aquarium for tmux sessions. each session is an animated ascii fish. active ones swim, busy ones bubble, sleeping ones sink. rust tui + axum api.

entries.name: sweet potato
entries.description: self-hostable auth + payments control plane. email/password, magic links, multi-wallet identity, application keys, stripe checkout/subscriptions/webhooks, tiered entitlements, pii encryption, and audit logs so multiple apps can agree on who a user is and what they paid for.

subitems.label: spaps-sdk
subitems.description: typescript client with permission checking, rbac, and dayrate scheduling

subitems.label: spaps
subitems.description: cli and docker compose orchestrator for local spaps server

subitems.label: spaps-server-quickstart, spaps-types, and spaps-issue-reporting-react
subitems.description: backend starter, shared contracts, and reusable feedback UI

entries.name: cfo
entries.description: ai-powered accounting infrastructure. quickbooks online compatible mcp server, client portal and advisory site, and a mobile financial assistant. built for cpas managing multiple company files.

entries.name: htma labs
entries.description: mineral analysis visualizations and recovery protocols for data driven holistic health practitioners and their clients.

entries.name: cycle chef
entries.description: practitioner-supervised, cycle-synced meal planning. ios app, backend api, public site, and component catalog for phase-aware nutrition workflows.

entries.name: skills
entries.description: a very particular set of skills for claude code.

entries.name: human as a service
entries.description: accountable, ai-augmented expertise. clients hire the responsible operator, not a chatbot: ai handles search, synthesis, critique, implementation, and packaging behind the scenes; the human owns context, judgment, communication, and final output. current shape: ai build diagnosis, production hardening, custom expert workflows, and private playbooks that stay private until they are safe to publish.

entries.name: clawgs
entries.description: terminal-native ai log analysis. stream, tag, and query shell output with llms.

entries.name: etcha
entries.description: turn a prompt into an etch a sketch tape. macos native, swift 6.

entries.name: dogswipe
entries.description: public codex "/goal" experiment in taking an ios/backend idea to production in roughly ~40 hours. Swipe-first local hotdog discovery, spaps auth, edge deploy, and TestFlight handoff.

entries.name: unclawg
entries.description: governed control plane for ai agent work. agents propose, humans approve.

entries.name: dream
entries.description: iphone-first lucid dream coach. local-first wake capture, nightmare patterns, and nightly ritual flow with cloud agents as session-time helpers.

entries.name: meaning
entries.description: local cli for asking a coding agent to compare multiple plausible framings of a lived moment. local-first reflection, provenance-aware lenses, explicit uncertainty, and safety boundaries instead of one overconfident ai answer.

footer.text: open to ai build diagnosis, production hardening, and implementation engagements
